- Keep the first line (the overall status) and the order of sections.
- Keep every cluster name listed under MUST KEEP.
- Remove words, never change them: copy every cluster name, version, date and number exactly as written.
  Do not add any new name, version, date or number.
- Drop the least important detail first: next-action phrasing, then ONGOING and lower-severity bullets,
  then the resolved line.
- Output only the shortened message.
